reply_text:
I replied to Kwame in his DM and did not set up the daily digest.

Reason: I can't confirm a scheduled job would post to his DM each morning. The scheduler I have runs locally and doesn't deliver into this Slack conversation, so a job could run without anyone seeing it. My reply tells him that and offers a digest on request. Someone with admin access to the scheduler would need to set up a real daily delivery.

Nothing was posted to #coastal-team, and I haven't read it yet. My first send attempt failed because the tool name was wrong, so only one DM went out.
